# Green block count went from 12 to 11. Gameplay changed: True.
# Mechanic confirmed: click on any green block to collect it, regardless of player position.
# 11 green blocks remaining. Let me collect them all in a batch.

# Get current green block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_blocks)}")

# Calculate center of each green block
clicks = []
for g in green_blocks:
    b = g['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})
    print(f"  Click: row {center_r}, col {center_c} (rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c})")

# Execute all clicks in a batch
result = action(clicks)
print(f"\nAfter batch click:")
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(green_blocks)}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
